steps.label: the garage shop shows the boat for sale
buying the boat: owned, on its trailer, $1500 paid, the motor offered next
steps.expect: r === 'bought: owned true, where trailer, money 3500, motor card true'

steps.label: the car with the trailer is parked by deep water, and LAUNCH is possible
steps.expect: /^car at -?\d+,-?\d+ facing away from the water; launch possible true$/.test(r)

steps.label: the LAUNCH pill shows in its driving place
the launched boat floats in deep enough water, at the water level
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^launched: where (\w+), water depth under the boat ([\d.]+), boat y (-?[\d.]+) level (-?[\d.]+)$/); return !!m && m[1] === 'water' && +m[2] > 0.45 && Math.abs(+m[3] - +m[4]) < 0.25; })()

steps.label: there is dry shore within boarding reach of the boat
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^on the shore ([\d.]+) m from the boat$/); return !!m && +m[1] < 7.5; })()

steps.label: on the shore by the boat the pill offers BOARD
4 s of gas: aboard at the helm, the boat speeds up (within its top speed), moves, stays afloat, and the speedo reads its speed in F
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^mode (\w+); after 4 s of gas: speed (-?[\d.]+) m\/s, moved ([\d.]+) m, still afloat (true|false), speedo (\d+) km\/h (\S+)$/); return !!m && m[1] === 'boat' && +m[2] > 4 && +m[2] <= 8.6 && +m[3] > 6 && +m[3] < 40 && m[4] === 'true' && Math.abs(+m[5] - +m[2] * 3.6) <= 4 && m[6] === 'F'; })()

steps.label: the camera button shows at the helm
the camera button swaps to the chase view
driving at the bridge pier, the boat is stopped by it and does not pass through it
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^bridge pier: start ([\d.]+) m away, closest the boat centre came ([\d.]+) m .*, now ([\d.]+) m, speed (-?[\d.]+)$/); return !!m && +m[2] >= 1.9 && +m[2] < 5 && +m[2] < +m[1]; })()

steps.label: the boat drives down to the falls but does not go over the lip
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^falls: drop ([\d.]+) m at s ([\d.]+), boat started at s ([\d.]+) and is now at s (-?\d+), lowest water under her (-?[\d.]+) m below the start$/); return !!m && +m[1] > 3 && +m[4] > +m[3] && +m[4] <= +m[2] + 1 && +m[5] < +m[1] / 2; })()

steps.label: the boat slows to a stop and the pill offers FISH
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^speed (-?[\d.]+), pill FISH$/); return !!m && Math.abs(+m[1]) < 1.5; })()

steps.label: fishing from the anchored boat: standing aboard with the rod, water to cast at, CAST button, out of the bears' reach
steps.expect: /^fishing from the boat: mode foot, aboard true, tool rod, water ahead true, primary CAST, pill \S+, bears can reach you false$/.test(r)

steps.label: fishing from the anchored boat the pill offers DRIVE (back to the helm)
the boat by the trailer: the pill offers LOAD BOAT
steps.expect: r === 'near the trailer: pill LOAD BOAT'

steps.label: the boat is back on the trailer and saved so, the player on foot, the car towing
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^loaded: where (\w+), player (\w+), saved boat (\{.*\}), car towing (true|false)$/); if (!m) return false; const b = JSON.parse(m[3]); return m[1] === 'trailer' && m[2] === 'foot' && b.owned === true && b.afloat === false && Number.isFinite(b.x) && Number.isFinite(b.z) && m[4] === 'true'; })()
